symptoms: Angular water-soaked spots on leaves bounded by veins
Boll rot and internal fibre staining
possibleCauses: High relative humidity (>80%) and leaf wetness
Warm temperature (24°C - 29°C)
Fungal spore carryover in plant debris

organic: Spray 5% Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE) at 50ml per liter of water
Apply Trichoderma viride bio-fungicide (5g/L water) to soil root zone
chemical: Streptocycline @ 0.1g + Copper Oxychloride @ 3.0g per liter of water
recommendedCare.immediateAction: Remove infected lower leaves immediately and avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation.

prevention: Practice 3-year crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops
Maintain 60cm row spacing for good canopy airflow
Mulch soil with dry grass or plastic to prevent soil splash
